entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: A catastrophic conflict on Otaria in Dominaria's Rift Era centered on the artifact the Mirari.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A singular artifact of unspeakable power whose lure corrupts all who hold it.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A continent on Dominaria, isolated by vast oceans, stage for the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane shattered a century earlier by the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A cabalist youth who finds the Mirari, later takes control of the Cabal and loses his humanity to the artifact.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal who enshrines the Mirari as the Cabal Pit's prize and is later banished by Chainer.

entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: Chainer's mentor, murdered in pit combat orchestrated by the First.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian drawn to Cabal City by the Mirari who ultimately rejects it and embraces the druids' teachings.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A noble centaur befriended by Kamahl; his druids resist the armies in Krosa.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: A lieutenant of the Order who seizes the Mirari, is driven mad, and dies when half the Citadel is crystallized.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: An exiled merfolk ambassador who schemes to return to power and manipulates events for the Mirari.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: The young leader of the Order who senses the Mirari's toxic influence and is encased in crystal by Kirtar.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: The mer emperor who seizes the Mirari in mad paranoia and dies after trying to flood Otaria.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A trickster who carries the Mirari back to Cabal City.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Widowed empress of the merfolk whose magic traps Laquatus's forces.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, nearly killed by him and left in eternal fiery torment by the Mirari.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: Mutual mentor of Kamahl and Jeska, later raised undead by dark magic.

entities.name: Calchexas
entities.description: The true name of Chainer's master, invoked as a secret weapon.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A power on Otaria centered at Cabal City, led by the First and then Chainer.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: An ascetic force bent on destroying relics, led by Pianna.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City where the Cabal Pit battles are held and the Mirari is enshrined.

entities.name: Cabal Pit
entities.description: Brutal arena whose prize was the Mirari.

entities.name: Citadel
entities.description: The Order's stronghold, half of which is encased in crystal.

entities.name: Aboshan Trench
entities.description: A trench created from the inundated shores of Otaria.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Southern city to which Chainer banishes the First.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Forest region where the final battles occur.

entities.name: Pardic Mountains
entities.description: Kamahl's barbarian homeland.

entities.name: Mirari Games
entities.description: Games Chainer launches to showcase his power, which become a massacre.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that shattered Dominaria a century earlier.

events.summary: Chainer unearths the Mirari at a forgotten villa outside Cabal City and presents it to the First, who enshrines it as the prize of the Cabal Pit.
events.quote: Chainer — ever loyal to the Cabal — presented it to The First

events.summary: Kamahl is drawn to Cabal City by rumor of the artifact and befriends Chainer and Seton.
events.quote: Befriending Chainer and the noble centaur Seton

events.summary: A Krosan dragon besieges Cabal City; Kamahl is crushed beneath its corpse and Kirtar seizes the glory and chooses the Mirari.
events.quote: Kirtar selected the Mirari, which granted him visions of dominion.

events.summary: Laquatus rewrites Kirtar's memory, sowing false alliances.
events.quote: Laquatus, ever the manipulator, had rewritten his memory

events.summary: Kirtar flees to the Order's lands, pursued by Kamahl and Laquatus.
events.quote: Kirtar fled back to the Order lands, pursued by Kamahl and Laquatus

events.summary: At the Citadel, Kirtar, mad from the Mirari, encases Pianna in crystal and triggers a disaster that crystallizes half the Citadel at the cost of his life force.
events.quote: encased her in pure crystal and unwittingly triggered a disaster

events.summary: The Mirari is spirited away to Emperor Aboshan's court.
events.quote: the Mirari was spirited away to Mer Emperor Aboshan 's court

events.summary: Aboshan seizes the Mirari; his plan to flood Otaria ends in his death and the creation of the Aboshan Trench.
events.quote: His genocidal designs to flood Otaria culminated in his death

events.summary: Braids carries the Mirari back to Cabal City.
events.quote: the Mirari returned to Cabal City, carried by the trickster Braids

events.summary: Chainer, having lost his mentor Skellum to pit combat arranged by the First, challenges the First with the Mirari and the name Calchexas.
events.quote: he challenged the First for leadership, wielding the Mirari

events.summary: Chainer banishes the First to Aphetto and takes control of the Cabal.
events.quote: Chainer banished him to the southern city of Aphetto and assumed control of the Cabal.

events.summary: The Mirari twists Chainer's body and mind; his Mirari Games become a massacre.
events.quote: Instead, the Games became a massacre.

events.summary: Attacked by Order forces, Chainer unleashes horrors from his dementia space upon Cabal City.
events.quote: Chainer unleashed every horror from his dementia space upon Cabal City.

events.summary: Kamahl duels Chainer, who loses his humanity and dissolves into monsters; Kamahl burns the remains with the Mirari.
events.quote: Kamahl, honoring his final plea, took up the Mirari and burned Chainer’s monstrous remains

events.summary: Laquatus's forces are trapped by Empress Llawan's magics.
events.quote: Laquatus’ forces collapsed into oblivion, trapped by the widowed Empress Llawan ’s cunning magics

events.summary: In the Pardic Mountains Kamahl organizes a brutal tournament, then nearly kills his sister Jeska, who is left in fiery torment by the Mirari; he rejects the artifact.
events.quote: Horrified, Kamahl finally rejected the artifact.

events.summary: Kamahl and Jeska are led into the Krosan Forest by Balthor Rockfist, pursued by the Cabal and Order remnants and Llawan's armies.
events.quote: Kamahl and his mortally wounded sister ventured into the Krosan Forest

events.summary: In Krosa, Laquatus's alliance collapses as Seton's druids resist and the undead Balthor hunts Laquatus.
events.quote: The alliance collapsed under its treacheries

events.summary: Kamahl embraces the druids' teachings and drives a sword through Laquatus into Krosa's soil, ending the battle but leaking the Mirari's influence into the soil.
events.quote: He plunged the sword through the body of Laquatus and into the forested ground of Krosa.
